summary: FFLA's New York list records a platform tower at High Peak (Stahahe) that is now gone; no other source found describes a structure there.

notes_for_editor: No story written. The FFLA list is the only source found. Searches for a tower on Stahahe High Peak returned only hiking pages and the separate Jackie Jones tower in Harriman. Andy Arthur's NYS DEC tower list returned HTTP 403. A story needs a source that describes a structure at this site; access and history are unknown.
